What is MCP? 4 facts for Kiro users

MCP in thirty seconds. Four facts.

1. A shared standard - One way for AI to use tools.
2. Direct calls - Kiro's agents call the tools directly.
3. No glue code - No custom integration code on your end.
4. Powers - Powers package a tool's know-how for Kiro.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/mcp/

Which one did you not know? Comment its number. theAIgurukul posts a Kiro tip every day - subscribe.
